# Appon Islam | Full Stack Developer & Software Engineer

> Full Stack Developer building high-performance, scalable, and modern web applications with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL. Focused on clean architecture, seamless user experience, and robust software engineering.

## Featured Projects
- [Bike Shop Application](https://www.apponislam.com/projects/bike-shop-application): Full-stack bike e-commerce platform with JWT-based authentication, role-based dashboards, product filters, and integrated SurjoPay payment system.
- [AP Classroom](https://www.apponislam.com/projects/ap-classroom): MERN-stack learning-management platform with role-based dashboards for students, teachers, and admins, featuring class management, assignments, and payments.
- [Appon Assignment Library](https://www.apponislam.com/projects/appon-assignment-library): Academic resource sharing and submission repository for university students with PDF previews and batch downloads.

## Core Capabilities & Tech Stack
- **Frontend:** Next.js, React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, HTML5, CSS3
- **Backend:** Node.js, Express.js, RESTful APIs, GraphQL, JWT, Firebase Authentication
- **Databases:** MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Mongoose, Prisma
- **Tools & Platforms:** Git, GitHub, Docker, Postman, Vercel, Netlify
